title: Constructor.io - High minimum contract value excludes smaller merchants
clean_text: Constructor.io's average contract value is reported at approximately $150,000 per year, positioning it well outside reach for small and mid-size ecommerce merchants. The platform requires significant onboarding investment, including a multi-week Proof Schedule process to assess gaps before full implementation. Pricing negotiations are described as results-driven, requiring customers to demonstrate expected ROI to justify the investment, which adds complexity to the buying process compared to flat-rate competitors.
